terra.problem: Saying Peter did not write from a cozy chair adds a detail about his circumstances that the text does not give.
The claim that Scripture uses building pictures elsewhere needs a reference outside this passage.
The joke about never shepherding a cookie does not connect clearly to why Peter is talking about people.
The line about cookies following what they see has no clear joke logic.
Calling the devil a lion drops Peter’s comparison, and saying he is not hiding adds a detail the text does not give.
Saying the baker is part of a family going through suffering assumes the baker is currently suffering.
The mention of Timothy in other letters needs a reference outside this passage.
